question: Urutkan deal yang sudah won berdasarkan nilai dan beri peringkat dari yang terbesar.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, rank() OVER (ORDER BY d.value DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' ORDER BY peringkat

question: kasih nomor urut ke tiap pelanggan berdasarkan tanggal daftar, yg paling lama duluan
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, c.created_at, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY c.created_at) AS nomor_urut FROM customers AS c FINAL ORDER BY nomor_urut

question: Tampilkan semua aktivitas dengan nomor urut per pelanggan berdasarkan waktu aktivitas.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp) AS urutan_aktivitas FROM activities AS a ORDER BY a.customer_id, urutan_aktivitas

question: Ranking tiket berstatus resolved berdasarkan resolution time paling lama.
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, t.resolution_time_hours, rank() OVER (ORDER BY t.resolution_time_hours DESC) AS peringkat FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status = 'resolved' AND t.resolution_time_hours IS NOT NULL ORDER BY peringkat

question: Hitung running total nilai semua deal berdasarkan tanggal deal dibuat.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.created_date, sum(d.value) OVER (ORDER BY d.created_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS total_kumulatif FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: Beri peringkat dense rank untuk deal pipeline berdasarkan probability tertinggi.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.probability, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY d.probability DESC) AS peringkat_probabilitas FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') ORDER BY peringkat_probabilitas

question: tampilin durasi tiap meeting + rata-rata durasi semua meeting buat pembanding
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, a.duration_minutes, round(avg(a.duration_minutes) OVER (), 2) AS rata_rata_durasi FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'meeting'

question: Tampilkan peringkat nilai deal di dalam masing-masing stage.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY d.stage ORDER BY d.value DESC) AS peringkat_di_stage FROM deals AS d FINAL ORDER BY d.stage, peringkat_di_stage

question: list sales rep dgn nomor urut per tim, urut berdasarkan nama
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, r.team, r.region, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY r.name) AS nomor_urut FROM sales_reps AS r ORDER BY r.team, nomor_urut

question: Tampilkan tiap deal beserta total nilai seluruh deal pada stage yang sama.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, sum(d.value) OVER (PARTITION BY d.stage) AS total_nilai_stage FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: Tampilkan nama setiap sales beserta jumlah anggota di timnya.
sql: SELECT r.name, count() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team) AS jumlah_sales_tim FROM sales_reps AS r

question: Untuk setiap aktivitas call, tampilkan waktu call sebelumnya ke pelanggan yang sama.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, lagInFrame(a.timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp) AS waktu_call_sebelumnya FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'call'

question: Beri nomor urut tiket per prioritas berdasarkan waktu tiket dibuat.
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.priority ORDER BY t.created_at) AS nomor_urut FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL ORDER BY t.priority, nomor_urut

question: Tampilkan deal won beserta nilai deal won terbesar milik sales yang sama.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.rep_id, max(d.value) OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id) AS nilai_terbesar_sales FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: brp persen nilai tiap deal won terhadap total omset keseluruhan?
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, round(d.value / sum(d.value) OVER (), 2) AS persen_dari_total FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: Urutkan pelanggan di tiap segmen dari yang paling baru daftar, kasih nomor urutnya.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, c.created_at, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment ORDER BY c.created_at DESC) AS urutan_terbaru FROM customers AS c FINAL ORDER BY c.segment, urutan_terbaru

question: Hitung jumlah kumulatif pelanggan berdasarkan tanggal pelanggan dibuat.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, c.created_at, count() OVER (ORDER BY c.created_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS jumlah_kumulatif FROM customers AS c FINAL

question: Tampilkan durasi tiap demo dan durasi demo berikutnya oleh sales yang sama.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, a.duration_minutes, leadInFrame(a.duration_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY a.rep_id ORDER BY a.timestamp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS durasi_demo_berikutnya FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'demo'

question: Bagi deal pipeline ke dalam 4 kelompok kuartil berdasarkan nilai, kuartil 1 paling besar.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, ntile(4) OVER (ORDER BY d.value DESC) AS kuartil FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')

question: Hitung selisih nilai setiap deal won dengan rata-rata nilai deal won.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, round(d.value - avg(d.value) OVER (), 2) AS selisih_dari_rata_rata FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: Peringkat tiket urgent yang sudah punya resolution time, yang tercepat nomor 1, dipisah per status tiket.
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, t.resolution_time_hours, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY t.status ORDER BY t.resolution_time_hours) AS peringkat FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.resolution_time_hours IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.status, peringkat

question: Tampilkan total durasi kumulatif aktivitas tiap sales seiring waktu.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, a.duration_minutes, sum(a.duration_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY a.rep_id ORDER BY a.timestamp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS durasi_kumulatif FROM activities AS a

question: Tampilkan setiap deal dan jumlah total deal yang dimiliki pelanggannya.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.customer_id, count() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id) AS jumlah_deal_pelanggan FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: Beri nomor urut deal untuk tiap pelanggan berdasarkan tanggal deal dibuat.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.customer_id, d.created_date, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date) AS deal_ke FROM deals AS d FINAL ORDER BY d.customer_id, deal_ke

question: Tampilkan deal lost beserta nilai deal lost sebelumnya menurut tanggal closing.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.closed_date, lagInFrame(d.value) OVER (ORDER BY d.closed_date) AS nilai_deal_sebelumnya FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'lost'

question: Ranking pelanggan berdasarkan jumlah tag yang dimiliki, paling banyak di atas.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, length(c.tags) AS jumlah_tag, rank() OVER (ORDER BY length(c.tags) DESC) AS peringkat FROM customers AS c FINAL ORDER BY peringkat

question: Tampilkan deal pipeline beserta rata-rata probability deal pipeline milik sales yang sama.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.rep_id, d.probability, round(avg(d.probability) OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id), 2) AS rata_rata_probabilitas_sales FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')

question: list email yg dikirim tiap sales, nomor 1 paling baru
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.rep_id ORDER BY a.timestamp DESC) AS urutan_terbaru FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'email' ORDER BY a.rep_id, urutan_terbaru

question: Tampilkan tiap tiket dengan resolution time tercepat di prioritas yang sama.
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, t.resolution_time_hours, min(t.resolution_time_hours) OVER (PARTITION BY t.priority) AS resolusi_tercepat_prioritas FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL

question: Tampilkan deal won dengan omset kumulatif berdasarkan tanggal closing.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.closed_date, sum(d.value) OVER (ORDER BY d.closed_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS omset_kumulatif FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: Ranking pelanggan Enterprise berdasarkan waktu update terbaru.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, c.updated_at, rank() OVER (ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC) AS peringkat FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise' ORDER BY peringkat

question: Tampilkan nilai kumulatif deal tiap pelanggan berdasarkan urutan tanggal dibuat.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.customer_id, d.created_date, sum(d.value) OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS nilai_kumulatif_pelanggan FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: Berapa persen durasi tiap aktivitas terhadap total durasi aktivitas sales yang sama?
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, a.duration_minutes, round(a.duration_minutes / sum(a.duration_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY a.rep_id), 2) AS persen_durasi FROM activities AS a

question: Untuk setiap deal, tampilkan judul deal dengan nilai terbesar di stage yang sama.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, first_value(d.title) OVER (PARTITION BY d.stage ORDER BY d.value DESC) AS deal_terbesar_di_stage FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: Tampilkan tiket beserta jumlah tiket pelanggan itu dengan prioritas yang sama.
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, count() OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id, t.priority) AS jumlah_tiket_prioritas_sama FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL

question: Peringkat deal negotiation berdasarkan probability, kalau sama lihat nilai deal terbesar.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.probability, rank() OVER (ORDER BY d.probability DESC, d.value DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'negotiation' ORDER BY peringkat

question: aktivitas yg sentimennya negatif dikasih nomor urut dari durasi paling lama
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, a.duration_minutes, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY a.duration_minutes DESC) AS nomor_urut FROM activities AS a WHERE a.sentiment = 'negative' ORDER BY nomor_urut

question: Tampilkan nilai deal sebelumnya (berdasarkan tanggal dibuat) untuk sales yang sama di setiap deal.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.rep_id, d.created_date, lagInFrame(d.value) OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id ORDER BY d.created_date) AS nilai_deal_sebelumnya FROM deals AS d FINAL

question: Tampilkan setiap pelanggan beserta nama pelanggan yang paling terakhir daftar di segmen yang sama.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, last_value(c.name) OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment ORDER BY c.created_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS pelanggan_terbaru_segmen FROM customers AS c FINAL

question: Tampilkan durasi aktivitas dan durasi maksimum untuk tipe aktivitas yang sama.
sql: SELECT a.duration_minutes, max(a.duration_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY a.type) AS durasi_maks_tipe FROM activities AS a

question: Hitung percent rank nilai deal won, dari terkecil ke terbesar.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, round(percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY d.value), 2) AS persentil FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' ORDER BY d.value

question: Tampilkan tiket tiap pelanggan dan urutan tiket ke berapa (kumulatif) berdasarkan waktu dibuat.
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, count() OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS tiket_ke FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL ORDER BY t.customer_id, tiket_ke

question: Beri dense rank pelanggan tier Gold berdasarkan tanggal daftar paling awal.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, c.created_at, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY c.created_at) AS peringkat FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.attributes['tier'] = 'Gold' ORDER BY peringkat

question: Hitung selisih nilai tiap deal proposal dengan deal proposal sebelumnya berdasarkan tanggal dibuat.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, x.created_date, x.selisih_nilai FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.created_date, d.value - lagInFrame(d.value) OVER (ORDER BY d.created_date) AS selisih_nilai, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY d.created_date) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'proposal') AS x WHERE x.rn > 1

question: Bagi aktivitas meeting ke 10 desil berdasarkan durasi, desil 1 paling lama.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, a.duration_minutes, ntile(10) OVER (ORDER BY a.duration_minutes DESC) AS desil FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type = 'meeting'

question: Rekap omset per bulan tahun ini beserta omset kumulatifnya.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_kumulatif FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Cari 3 deal dengan nilai terbesar di setiap stage.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.stage ORDER BY d.value DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL) AS x WHERE x.rn <= 3

question: aktivitas terakhir tiap pelanggan apa aja?
sql: SELECT x.activity_id, x.customer_id, x.rep_id, x.type, x.timestamp FROM (SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM activities AS a) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1

question: Ranking sales rep berdasarkan omset bulan lalu.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS omset, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY peringkat

question: Tampilkan omset per bulan tahun ini dan selisihnya dibanding bulan sebelumnya.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, sum(d.value) - lagInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS selisih_bulan_sebelumnya FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Hitung jumlah tiket per bulan tahun ini dengan rata-rata bergerak 3 bulan.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_tiket, round(avg(count()) OVER (ORDER BY bulan ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS rata_rata_bergerak_3_bulan FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Berapa persen kontribusi omset tiap sales terhadap total omset tahun ini?
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS omset, round(sum(d.value) / sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (), 2) AS persen_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY persen_omset DESC

question: Tampilkan deal pertama yang pernah dibuat oleh setiap pelanggan.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, x.customer_id, x.created_date FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.customer_id, d.created_date, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1

question: rekap pelanggan baru per bulan tahun ini + total kumulatifnya
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(c.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS pelanggan_baru, sum(count()) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS kumulatif_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Cari 5 tiket dengan resolution time terlama di setiap prioritas.
sql: SELECT x.ticket_id, x.customer_id, x.priority, x.status, x.created_at, x.resolution_time_hours FROM (SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, t.resolution_time_hours, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.priority ORDER BY t.resolution_time_hours DESC) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.resolution_time_hours IS NOT NULL) AS x WHERE x.rn <= 5

question: Dense rank pelanggan berdasarkan jumlah aktivitas dalam 30 hari terakhir.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY count() DESC) AS peringkat FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 30) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY peringkat

question: Rekap jumlah aktivitas per minggu dalam 90 hari terakhir dan selisihnya dengan minggu sebelumnya.
sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(a.timestamp, 1) AS minggu, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, count() - lagInFrame(count()) OVER (ORDER BY minggu) AS selisih_minggu_sebelumnya FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 90) GROUP BY minggu ORDER BY minggu

question: Urutkan tipe aktivitas berdasarkan rata-rata durasi dan beri peringkat.
sql: SELECT a.type, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_rata_durasi, rank() OVER (ORDER BY avg(a.duration_minutes) DESC) AS peringkat FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.type ORDER BY peringkat

question: Tampilkan aktivitas kedua dari setiap pelanggan.
sql: SELECT x.activity_id, x.customer_id, x.rep_id, x.type, x.timestamp FROM (SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp) AS rn FROM activities AS a) AS x WHERE x.rn = 2

question: jumlah tiket per hari 30 hari terakhir, plus rata-rata bergerak 7 hari
sql: SELECT toDate(t.created_at) AS tanggal, count() AS jumlah_tiket, round(avg(count()) OVER (ORDER BY tanggal ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS rata_rata_7_hari FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= subtractDays(now(), 30) GROUP BY tanggal ORDER BY tanggal

question: Cari deal pipeline terbaru milik masing-masing sales.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, x.rep_id, x.created_date FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.rep_id, d.created_date, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id ORDER BY d.created_date DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1

question: Tampilkan 10 pelanggan dengan omset terbesar tahun ini beserta peringkatnya.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, sum(d.value) AS omset, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY peringkat LIMIT 10

question: Berapa hari jarak antara deal won dengan deal won sebelumnya untuk sales yang sama?
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, x.rep_id, x.closed_date, x.jarak_hari FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.rep_id, d.closed_date, dateDiff('day', lagInFrame(d.closed_date) OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id ORDER BY d.closed_date), d.closed_date) AS jarak_hari, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id ORDER BY d.closed_date) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won') AS x WHERE x.rn > 1

question: Rekap jumlah tiket per prioritas per bulan tahun ini dengan running total di tiap prioritas.
sql: SELECT t.priority, toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_tiket, sum(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY t.priority ORDER BY bulan) AS total_kumulatif FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY t.priority, bulan ORDER BY t.priority, bulan

question: Hitung persentase pelanggan aktif di tiap segmen terhadap total pelanggan aktif.
sql: SELECT c.segment, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan, round(count() / sum(count()) OVER (), 2) AS persen_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'active' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY persen_pelanggan DESC

question: Tipe aktivitas apa yang paling sering dilakukan oleh tiap sales?
sql: SELECT x.rep_id, x.name, x.type, x.jumlah_aktivitas FROM (SELECT r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name, a.type, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.rep_id ORDER BY count() DESC) AS rn FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name, a.type) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 ORDER BY x.rep_id

question: Siapa saja pelanggan yang masuk 3 peringkat teratas (dense rank) jumlah tiket?
sql: SELECT x.customer_id, x.name, x.jumlah_tiket, x.peringkat FROM (SELECT c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_tiket, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY count() DESC) AS peringkat FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name) AS x WHERE x.peringkat <= 3 ORDER BY x.peringkat

question: Hitung akumulasi nilai pipeline mulai dari deal pipeline terbesar.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, sum(d.value) OVER (ORDER BY d.value DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS akumulasi_pipeline FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') ORDER BY d.value DESC

question: Rata-rata bergerak durasi 5 aktivitas terakhir untuk tiap sales.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, a.duration_minutes, round(avg(a.duration_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY a.rep_id ORDER BY a.timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS rata_rata_5_aktivitas FROM activities AS a

question: Bandingkan jumlah deal yang dibuat tiap bulan tahun ini dengan bulan sebelumnya dalam persen.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.created_date) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_deal, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS jumlah_bulan_sebelumnya, round((jumlah_deal - jumlah_bulan_sebelumnya) / nullIf(jumlah_bulan_sebelumnya, 0), 2) AS pertumbuhan_persen FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.created_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Ranking produk berdasarkan jumlah deal won yang melibatkannya.
sql: SELECT product, count() AS jumlah_deal, rank() OVER (ORDER BY count() DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY product ORDER BY peringkat

question: Urutkan wilayah pelanggan berdasarkan jumlah pelanggan aktif dan beri peringkat.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan, rank() OVER (ORDER BY count() DESC) AS peringkat FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'active' GROUP BY wilayah ORDER BY peringkat

question: Bagi pelanggan ke 10 desil berdasarkan jumlah deal, desil 1 yg paling banyak deal.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_deal, ntile(10) OVER (ORDER BY count() DESC) AS desil FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY desil, jumlah_deal DESC

question: Tampilkan aktivitas hari ini dengan nomor urut per sales berdasarkan jam.
sql: SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.rep_id ORDER BY a.timestamp) AS urutan FROM activities AS a WHERE toDate(a.timestamp) = today() ORDER BY a.rep_id, urutan

question: Tampilkan tiket terbuka paling baru untuk setiap pelanggan.
sql: SELECT x.ticket_id, x.customer_id, x.priority, x.status, x.created_at FROM (SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at DESC) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress')) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1

question: list 2 deal won terbesar tiap sales kuartal ini
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, x.rep_id FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.rep_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id ORDER BY d.value DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfQuarter(today())) AS x WHERE x.rn <= 2

question: Rekap jumlah aktivitas bersentimen negatif per minggu tahun ini beserta jumlah kumulatifnya.
sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(a.timestamp, 1) AS minggu, count() AS jumlah_negatif, sum(count()) OVER (ORDER BY minggu) AS kumulatif_negatif FROM activities AS a WHERE a.sentiment = 'negative' AND a.timestamp >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY minggu ORDER BY minggu

question: Peringkat industri berdasarkan jumlah pelanggan yang churn.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['industry'] AS industri, count() AS jumlah_churn, rank() OVER (ORDER BY count() DESC) AS peringkat FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'churned' GROUP BY industri ORDER BY peringkat

question: Hitung selisih nilai tiap deal won dengan deal won terbesar milik sales yang sama.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.rep_id, max(d.value) OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id) - d.value AS selisih_dari_terbesar FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won'

question: Cari pelanggan yang aktivitas terakhirnya bersentimen negatif.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM (SELECT a.customer_id, a.sentiment, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM activities AS a) AS x INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON x.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE x.rn = 1 AND x.sentiment = 'negative'

question: Berapa hari jeda antara tiap pelanggan baru dengan pelanggan sebelumnya yang daftar tahun ini?
sql: SELECT x.customer_id, x.name, x.company, x.status, x.segment, x.created_at, x.jeda_hari FROM (SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, c.created_at, dateDiff('day', lagInFrame(c.created_at) OVER (ORDER BY c.created_at), c.created_at) AS jeda_hari, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY c.created_at) AS rn FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today())) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1

question: Rekap jumlah deal won per kuartal dan selisihnya dengan kuartal sebelumnya.
sql: SELECT toStartOfQuarter(d.closed_date) AS kuartal, count() AS jumlah_won, count() - lagInFrame(count()) OVER (ORDER BY kuartal) AS selisih_kuartal_sebelumnya FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY kuartal ORDER BY kuartal

question: running total omset harian bulan ini dong
sql: SELECT toDate(d.closed_date) AS tanggal, sum(d.value) AS omset, sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY tanggal) AS omset_kumulatif FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY tanggal ORDER BY tanggal

question: Rata-rata resolution time tiket per bulan tahun ini beserta rata-rata bergeraknya selama 3 bulan.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_rata_resolusi, round(avg(avg(t.resolution_time_hours)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS rata_rata_bergerak FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Untuk tiap deal, tampilkan tanggal deal berikutnya dari pelanggan yang sama dan jaraknya dalam hari.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, x.customer_id, x.created_date, x.tanggal_deal_berikutnya, x.jarak_hari FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.customer_id, d.created_date, leadInFrame(d.created_date) OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS tanggal_deal_berikutnya, dateDiff('day', d.created_date, tanggal_deal_berikutnya) AS jarak_hari, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date DESC) AS rn_akhir FROM deals AS d FINAL) AS x WHERE x.rn_akhir > 1

question: Cari 3 pelanggan dengan tag terbanyak di tiap segmen.
sql: SELECT x.customer_id, x.name, x.company, x.status, x.segment, x.jumlah_tag FROM (SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment, length(c.tags) AS jumlah_tag, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment ORDER BY length(c.tags) DESC) AS rn FROM customers AS c FINAL) AS x WHERE x.rn <= 3

question: Berapa persen total durasi tiap tipe aktivitas dari seluruh durasi aktivitas 90 hari terakhir?
sql: SELECT a.type, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi, round(sum(a.duration_minutes) / sum(sum(a.duration_minutes)) OVER (), 2) AS persen_durasi FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 90) GROUP BY a.type ORDER BY persen_durasi DESC

question: Nomori tiket urgent tiap pelanggan yang dibuat tahun ini berdasarkan waktu dibuat.
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at) AS tiket_urgent_ke FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) ORDER BY t.customer_id, tiket_urgent_ke

question: Rekap jumlah dan nilai deal won per bulan tahun ini, masing-masing dengan kumulatifnya.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_won, sum(count()) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS jumlah_won_kumulatif, sum(d.value) AS omset, sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_kumulatif FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Urutkan stage pipeline berdasarkan weighted forecast dan kasih peringkat.
sql: SELECT d.stage, sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) AS forecast, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY d.stage ORDER BY peringkat

question: Rekap pelanggan baru per minggu 90 hari terakhir dan bandingkan dengan minggu sebelumnya.
sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(c.created_at, 1) AS minggu, count() AS pelanggan_baru, lagInFrame(count()) OVER (ORDER BY minggu) AS pelanggan_baru_minggu_lalu FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.created_at >= subtractDays(now(), 90) GROUP BY minggu ORDER BY minggu

question: Dense rank pelanggan yang punya tiket high atau urgent, berdasarkan jumlah tiket high dan urgent-nya (terbanyak = peringkat 1).
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_tiket, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY count() DESC) AS peringkat FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.priority IN ('high','urgent') GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY peringkat

question: Total durasi call tiap sales per bulan tahun ini dengan running total per sales.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, toStartOfMonth(a.timestamp) AS bulan, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi, sum(sum(a.duration_minutes)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.rep_id ORDER BY bulan) AS durasi_kumulatif FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.type = 'call' AND a.timestamp >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name, bulan ORDER BY r.rep_id, bulan

question: Cari deal yang nilainya di atas rata-rata nilai deal di stage-nya sendiri.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, round(x.avg_stage, 2) AS rata_rata_stage FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, avg(d.value) OVER (PARTITION BY d.stage) AS avg_stage FROM deals AS d FINAL) AS x WHERE x.value > x.avg_stage

question: Tampilkan aktivitas yang durasinya lebih lama dari aktivitas sebelumnya ke pelanggan yang sama.
sql: SELECT x.activity_id, x.customer_id, x.rep_id, x.type, x.timestamp, x.duration_minutes, x.durasi_sebelumnya FROM (SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, a.duration_minutes, lagInFrame(a.duration_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp) AS durasi_sebelumnya, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp) AS rn FROM activities AS a) AS x WHERE x.rn > 1 AND x.duration_minutes > x.durasi_sebelumnya

question: bulan apa yg omsetnya paling gede tahun ini? kasih ranking semua bulan
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY peringkat

question: Hitung kontribusi persen tiap produk terhadap total nilai deal won yang melibatkan produk tersebut.
sql: SELECT product, sum(d.value) AS total_nilai, round(sum(d.value) / sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (), 2) AS persen_kontribusi FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY product ORDER BY persen_kontribusi DESC

question: Cari tiket yang resolution time-nya lebih lama dari rata-rata prioritasnya.
sql: SELECT x.ticket_id, x.customer_id, x.priority, x.status, x.created_at, x.resolution_time_hours, round(x.avg_prioritas, 2) AS rata_rata_prioritas FROM (SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, t.resolution_time_hours, avg(t.resolution_time_hours) OVER (PARTITION BY t.priority) AS avg_prioritas FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.resolution_time_hours IS NOT NULL) AS x WHERE x.resolution_time_hours > x.avg_prioritas

question: Jumlah aktivitas per hari selama 14 hari terakhir beserta totalnya yang terus bertambah.
sql: SELECT toDate(a.timestamp) AS tanggal, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, sum(count()) OVER (ORDER BY tanggal) AS jumlah_kumulatif FROM activities AS a WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 14) GROUP BY tanggal ORDER BY tanggal

question: Ranking pelanggan SMB berdasarkan total nilai deal pipeline-nya.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, sum(d.value) AS nilai_pipeline, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND c.segment = 'SMB' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY peringkat

question: Tampilkan tiket closed dengan resolution time kumulatif per prioritas berdasarkan waktu dibuat.
sql: SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, t.resolution_time_hours, sum(t.resolution_time_hours) OVER (PARTITION BY t.priority ORDER BY t.created_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS resolusi_kumulatif FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status = 'closed'

question: Rekap jumlah tiket per status dan persentasenya dari total tiket bulan ini.
sql: SELECT t.status, count() AS jumlah_tiket, round(count() / sum(count()) OVER (), 2) AS persen_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY t.status ORDER BY persen_tiket DESC

question: Hitung win rate tiap sales tahun ini dan ranking-kan.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate, rank() OVER (ORDER BY countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY peringkat

question: Ranking sales berdasarkan total nilai pipeline, tapi cuma yang totalnya di atas 30 juta.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS nilai_pipeline, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING nilai_pipeline > 30000000 ORDER BY peringkat

question: Siapa 3 sales dengan omset tertinggi tahun ini di tiap wilayah sales?
sql: SELECT x.region, x.rep_id, x.name, x.omset FROM (SELECT r.region, r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS omset, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.region, r.rep_id, r.name) AS x WHERE x.rn <= 3 ORDER BY x.region, x.omset DESC

question: Tampilkan perusahaan dengan omset terbesar di setiap segmen.
sql: SELECT x.segment, x.company, x.omset FROM (SELECT c.segment, c.company, sum(d.value) AS omset, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.segment, c.company) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 ORDER BY x.segment

question: Rekap omset bulanan tahun ini dengan pertumbuhan persen dibanding bulan sebelumnya dan omset kumulatif.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, lagInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_bulan_sebelumnya, round((omset - omset_bulan_sebelumnya) / nullIf(omset_bulan_sebelumnya, 0), 2) AS pertumbuhan_persen, sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_kumulatif FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan ORDER BY bulan

question: Ranking win rate sales di dalam timnya masing-masing.
sql: SELECT r.team, r.rep_id, r.name, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team, r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY r.team, peringkat

question: Urutkan tim sales berdasarkan weighted pipeline, tampilkan peringkat dan persentasenya dari total forecast.
sql: SELECT r.team, sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) AS forecast, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) DESC) AS peringkat, round(sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) / sum(sum(d.value * d.probability / 100)) OVER (), 2) AS persen_forecast FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY peringkat

question: 2 industri dengan pelanggan aktif terbanyak di setiap wilayah pelanggan apa aja?
sql: SELECT x.wilayah, x.industri, x.jumlah_pelanggan FROM (SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, c.attributes['industry'] AS industri, count() AS jumlah_pelanggan, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY wilayah ORDER BY count() DESC) AS rn FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'active' GROUP BY wilayah, industri) AS x WHERE x.rn <= 2 ORDER BY x.wilayah, x.jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Tampilkan aktivitas terakhir tiap pelanggan beserta nama perusahaan dan nama sales yang menanganinya.
sql: SELECT x.activity_id, x.customer_id, x.rep_id, x.type, x.timestamp, c.company, r.name AS rep_name FROM (SELECT a.activity_id, a.customer_id, a.rep_id, a.type, a.timestamp, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM activities AS a) AS x INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON x.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON x.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE x.rn = 1

question: Cari 5 pelanggan Enterprise dengan tiket terbuka terbanyak di tiap wilayah pelanggan.
sql: SELECT x.wilayah, x.customer_id, x.name, x.jumlah_tiket_terbuka FROM (SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_tiket_terbuka, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY wilayah ORDER BY count() DESC) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress') AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' GROUP BY wilayah, c.customer_id, c.name) AS x WHERE x.rn <= 5 ORDER BY x.wilayah, x.jumlah_tiket_terbuka DESC

question: Hitung rata-rata bergerak 3 bulan omset per wilayah sales sepanjang tahun ini.
sql: SELECT r.region, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, round(avg(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region ORDER BY bulan ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS rata_rata_bergerak_3_bulan FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.region, bulan ORDER BY r.region, bulan

question: Rekap omset per bulan per segmen tahun ini beserta persentase tiap segmen terhadap omset bulan itu.
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, c.segment, sum(d.value) AS omset, round(sum(d.value) / sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY bulan), 2) AS persen_omset_bulan FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan, c.segment ORDER BY bulan, c.segment

question: Bandingkan peringkat omset tiap sales bulan ini dengan peringkatnya bulan lalu.
sql: WITH ini AS (SELECT d.rep_id, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat_bulan_ini FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY d.rep_id), lalu AS (SELECT d.rep_id, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat_bulan_lalu FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY d.rep_id) SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, ini.peringkat_bulan_ini, lalu.peringkat_bulan_lalu FROM ini INNER JOIN lalu ON ini.rep_id = lalu.rep_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON ini.rep_id = r.rep_id ORDER BY ini.peringkat_bulan_ini

question: Siapa 10 pelanggan dengan jeda terpanjang antar dua aktivitas berturut-turut?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, max(x.jeda_hari) AS jeda_terpanjang FROM (SELECT a.customer_id, dateDiff('day', lagInFrame(a.timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp), a.timestamp) AS jeda_hari, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp) AS rn FROM activities AS a) AS x INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON x.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE x.rn > 1 GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY jeda_terpanjang DESC LIMIT 10

question: Untuk setiap produk, cari deal won dengan nilai terbesar beserta nama perusahaan pelanggannya.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, x.product, c.company FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, product, d.customer_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY product ORDER BY d.value DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product WHERE d.stage = 'won') AS x INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON x.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE x.rn = 1

question: Ranking sales berdasarkan total durasi meeting kuartal ini di dalam wilayah sales masing-masing.
sql: SELECT r.region, r.rep_id, r.name, sum(a.duration_minutes) AS total_durasi_meeting, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region ORDER BY sum(a.duration_minutes) DESC) AS peringkat FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.type = 'meeting' AND a.timestamp >= toStartOfQuarter(today()) GROUP BY r.region, r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY r.region, peringkat

question: Rekap jumlah pelanggan churn per bulan berdasarkan tanggal update tahun ini, kumulatif per segmen.
sql: SELECT c.segment, toStartOfMonth(c.updated_at) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_churn, sum(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment ORDER BY bulan) AS churn_kumulatif FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.status = 'churned' AND c.updated_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY c.segment, bulan ORDER BY c.segment, bulan

question: Di tiap tahun, bulan mana yang punya tiket urgent paling banyak?
sql: SELECT x.tahun, x.bulan, x.jumlah_urgent FROM (SELECT toYear(t.created_at) AS tahun, toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS jumlah_urgent, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY tahun ORDER BY count() DESC) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' GROUP BY tahun, bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 ORDER BY x.tahun

question: Cari pelanggan yang 3 aktivitas terakhirnya semuanya bersentimen negatif.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT x.customer_id FROM (SELECT a.customer_id, a.sentiment, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM activities AS a) AS x WHERE x.rn <= 3 GROUP BY x.customer_id HAVING count() = 3 AND countIf(x.sentiment = 'negative') = 3)

question: Berapa persen kontribusi omset tiap sales terhadap omset timnya tahun ini?
sql: SELECT r.team, r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS omset, round(sum(d.value) / sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.team), 2) AS persen_omset_tim FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.team, r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY r.team, persen_omset_tim DESC

question: Analisis pareto: pelanggan mana saja yang omset kumulatifnya masih dalam 80% total omset tahun ini, diurutkan dari omset terbesar?
sql: SELECT x.customer_id, x.name, x.omset, round(x.omset_kumulatif / x.total_omset, 2) AS rasio_kumulatif FROM (SELECT c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name, sum(d.value) AS omset, sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS omset_kumulatif, sum(sum(d.value)) OVER () AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name) AS x WHERE x.omset_kumulatif <= x.total_omset * 0.8 ORDER BY x.omset DESC

question: Ranking tier pelanggan berdasarkan rata-rata resolution time tiket, dari yang paling cepat.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['tier'] AS tier, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_rata_resolusi, rank() OVER (ORDER BY avg(t.resolution_time_hours)) AS peringkat FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY tier ORDER BY peringkat

question: siapa sales paling banyak demo bulan lalu di tiap tim?
sql: SELECT x.team, x.rep_id, x.name, x.jumlah_demo FROM (SELECT r.team, r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_demo, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY count() DESC) AS rn FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.type = 'demo' AND a.timestamp >= toStartOfMonth(subtractMonths(today(), 1)) AND a.timestamp < toStartOfMonth(today()) GROUP BY r.team, r.rep_id, r.name) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 ORDER BY x.team

question: Tampilkan peringkat omset sales tahun ini dan selisih omsetnya dengan sales satu peringkat di atasnya.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS omset, rank() OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat, lagInFrame(sum(d.value)) OVER (ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) - sum(d.value) AS selisih_dengan_atasnya FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY peringkat

question: Rekap pelanggan baru per bulan per wilayah pelanggan tahun ini, plus total kumulatif tiap wilayah.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, toStartOfMonth(c.created_at) AS bulan, count() AS pelanggan_baru, sum(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY wilayah ORDER BY bulan) AS kumulatif_wilayah FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY wilayah, bulan ORDER BY wilayah, bulan

question: Cari pelanggan yang deal terakhirnya (berdasarkan tanggal dibuat) berakhir lost, tampilkan nama dan perusahaannya.
sql: SELECT c.name, c.company FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, d.deal_id, d.stage, d.created_date, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL) AS x INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON x.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE x.rn = 1 AND x.stage = 'lost'

question: Top 3 pelanggan per segmen berdasarkan jumlah aktivitas 90 hari terakhir, tampilkan namanya.
sql: SELECT x.segment, x.customer_id, x.name, x.jumlah_aktivitas FROM (SELECT c.segment, c.customer_id AS customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment ORDER BY count() DESC) AS rn FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 90) GROUP BY c.segment, c.customer_id, c.name) AS x WHERE x.rn <= 3 ORDER BY x.segment, x.jumlah_aktivitas DESC

question: Tampilkan deal won yang nilainya lebih dari 2 kali rata-rata deal won sales tersebut, lengkap dengan nama sales.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, r.name AS rep_name, round(x.avg_sales, 2) AS rata_rata_sales FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.rep_id, avg(d.value) OVER (PARTITION BY d.rep_id) AS avg_sales FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage = 'won') AS x INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON x.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE x.value > 2 * x.avg_sales

question: Rekap jumlah aktivitas mingguan per tim dalam 60 hari terakhir dan selisihnya dibanding minggu sebelumnya (minggu pertama tetap ditampilkan, dibandingkan dengan 0).
sql: SELECT r.team, toStartOfWeek(a.timestamp, 1) AS minggu, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, count() - lagInFrame(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY minggu) AS selisih_minggu_sebelumnya FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 60) GROUP BY r.team, minggu ORDER BY r.team, minggu

question: Berapa hari selisih antara deal pertama dan deal kedua tiap pelanggan?
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, dateDiff('day', x.tanggal_deal_sebelumnya, x.created_date) AS selisih_hari FROM (SELECT d.customer_id, d.created_date, lagInFrame(d.created_date) OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date) AS tanggal_deal_sebelumnya, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.created_date) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL) AS x INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON x.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE x.rn = 2 ORDER BY c.customer_id

question: Ranking produk berdasarkan omset di setiap wilayah pelanggan.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah, product, sum(d.value) AS omset, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY wilayah ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY wilayah, product ORDER BY wilayah, peringkat

question: Hitung win rate per kuartal untuk tiap tim beserta perubahannya dari kuartal sebelumnya.
sql: SELECT r.team, toStartOfQuarter(d.closed_date) AS kuartal, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate, round(win_rate - lagInFrame(win_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY kuartal), 2) AS perubahan_win_rate FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('won','lost') GROUP BY r.team, kuartal ORDER BY r.team, kuartal

question: Cari pelanggan yang pernah membuat 2 tiket atau lebih dalam rentang 7 hari.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.company, c.status, c.segment FROM customers AS c FINAL WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT x.customer_id FROM (SELECT t.customer_id, count() OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY toDate(t.created_at) RANGE BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS tiket_7_hari FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL) AS x WHERE x.tiket_7_hari >= 2)

question: Rekap weighted pipeline per bulan deal dibuat tahun ini untuk tiap stage, dengan kumulatif per stage.
sql: SELECT d.stage, toStartOfMonth(d.created_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value * d.probability / 100) AS forecast, sum(sum(d.value * d.probability / 100)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.stage ORDER BY bulan) AS forecast_kumulatif FROM deals AS d FINAL WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND d.created_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY d.stage, bulan ORDER BY d.stage, bulan

question: list 2 deal terbesar tiap pelanggan tier Gold, sertakan nama perusahaannya
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, x.company FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, c.company, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.value DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.attributes['tier'] = 'Gold') AS x WHERE x.rn <= 2

question: Tampilkan peringkat omset tiap sales di wilayah sales-nya sekaligus porsi omsetnya terhadap total wilayah, untuk tahun ini.
sql: SELECT r.region, r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS omset, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat_wilayah, round(sum(d.value) / sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region), 2) AS persen_omset_wilayah FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.region, r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY r.region, peringkat_wilayah

question: Berapa rata-rata jeda hari antar aktivitas berturut-turut untuk tiap sales? Tampilkan nama sales.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(avg(x.jeda_hari), 2) AS rata_rata_jeda_hari FROM (SELECT a.rep_id, dateDiff('day', lagInFrame(a.timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY a.rep_id ORDER BY a.timestamp), a.timestamp) AS jeda_hari, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY a.rep_id ORDER BY a.timestamp) AS rn FROM activities AS a) AS x INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON x.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE x.rn > 1 GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY rata_rata_jeda_hari

question: Rekap omset per bulan untuk tiap segmen pelanggan tahun ini dengan omset kumulatif per segmen.
sql: SELECT c.segment, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.segment ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_kumulatif FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY c.segment, bulan ORDER BY c.segment, bulan

question: Bulan terbaik tiap sales tahun ini berdasarkan omset, tampilkan nama sales dan omsetnya.
sql: SELECT x.rep_id, x.name, x.bulan, x.omset FROM (SELECT r.rep_id AS rep_id, r.name, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.rep_id ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS rn FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name, bulan) AS x WHERE x.rn = 1 ORDER BY x.name

question: Tampilkan tiket terbuka tertua tiap pelanggan Enterprise beserta nama perusahaannya.
sql: SELECT x.ticket_id, x.customer_id, x.priority, x.status, x.created_at, x.company FROM (SELECT t.ticket_id, t.customer_id, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, c.company, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id ORDER BY t.created_at) AS rn FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress') AND c.segment = 'Enterprise') AS x WHERE x.rn = 1

question: Ranking tim berdasarkan rata-rata nilai deal won di setiap kuartal.
sql: SELECT toStartOfQuarter(d.closed_date) AS kuartal, r.team, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_rata_nilai, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY kuartal ORDER BY avg(d.value) DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY kuartal, r.team ORDER BY kuartal, peringkat

question: Hitung berapa kali sentimen aktivitas tiap pelanggan berubah dari positive langsung ke negative.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, countIf(x.sentimen_sebelumnya = 'positive' AND x.sentiment = 'negative') AS jumlah_perubahan FROM (SELECT a.customer_id, a.sentiment, lagInFrame(a.sentiment) OVER (PARTITION BY a.customer_id ORDER BY a.timestamp) AS sentimen_sebelumnya FROM activities AS a) AS x INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON x.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING jumlah_perubahan > 0 ORDER BY jumlah_perubahan DESC

question: Omset kumulatif bulanan per wilayah sales tahun ini.
sql: SELECT r.region, toStartOfMonth(d.closed_date) AS bulan, sum(d.value) AS omset, sum(sum(d.value)) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region ORDER BY bulan) AS omset_kumulatif FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.region, bulan ORDER BY r.region, bulan

question: Cari deal yang masuk 10% teratas berdasarkan nilai di tiap stage, tampilkan juga nama sales-nya.
sql: SELECT x.deal_id, x.title, x.stage, x.value, r.name AS rep_name FROM (SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.rep_id, ntile(10) OVER (PARTITION BY d.stage ORDER BY d.value DESC) AS desil FROM deals AS d FINAL) AS x INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON x.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE x.desil = 1

question: Bandingkan jumlah aktivitas tiap sales 30 hari terakhir dengan rata-rata jumlah aktivitas di timnya.
sql: SELECT r.team, r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas, round(avg(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY r.team), 2) AS rata_rata_tim, round(count() / avg(count()) OVER (PARTITION BY r.team), 2) AS rasio_terhadap_tim FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 30) GROUP BY r.team, r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY r.team, rasio_terhadap_tim DESC

question: Dense rank produk berdasarkan jumlah deal won di tiap tim sales.
sql: SELECT r.team, product, count() AS jumlah_deal, dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY r.team ORDER BY count() DESC) AS peringkat FROM deals AS d FINAL ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS product INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team, product ORDER BY r.team, peringkat

question: Untuk tiap pelanggan Mid-Market, tampilkan nilai deal won kumulatif berdasarkan tanggal closing beserta nama perusahaannya.
sql: SELECT d.deal_id, d.title, d.stage, d.value, d.closed_date, c.company, sum(d.value) OVER (PARTITION BY d.customer_id ORDER BY d.closed_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS omset_kumulatif FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.segment = 'Mid-Market'

question: rekap rata2 resolution time tiket per bulan per prioritas tahun ini, terus kasih ranking prioritas tiap bulan dari yg paling lambat
sql: SELECT toStartOfMonth(t.created_at) AS bulan, t.priority, round(avg(t.resolution_time_hours), 2) AS rata_rata_resolusi, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY bulan ORDER BY avg(t.resolution_time_hours) DESC) AS peringkat FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.created_at >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY bulan, t.priority ORDER BY bulan, peringkat
